results.title: Asian Games 2026: Indian men's badminton team settles for bronze after semi-final loss to China
results.description: The medal marks only the second time India have stood on the podium in badminton at the Asian Games. Their previous medal came at the 2023 Hangzhou Games, where Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty captured the men’s doubles gold.
